title: The cross-ratio (A, B; C, D) = 9/8
caption: With A, B, C, D at 0, 1, 3, 4 the distances are AC = 3, BD = 3, BC = 2, AD = 4, so (A, B; C, D) = (3 × 3)/(2 × 4) = 9/8.
alt: A number line with the four points A, B, C, D at 0, 1, 3 and 4.
description: The points A, B, C, D sit at 0, 1, 3 and 4.
The cross-ratio is (3 × 3)/(2 × 4) = 9/8, unchanged by any projection of the line.
